post.summary: Login with Login ID and password
post.description:
Authenticates a user by Login (== Email) and bcrypt-hashed password.

UI Rule: If IsFirstTime=True, the frontend must redirect to the password-reset screen.
The is_first_time flag is included in the response for this purpose.

Allows an authenticated user to change their password.
- Verifies current_password against stored hash.
- Hashes new_password and saves it.
- Sets IsFirstTime=False (clears forced-reset flag).

UI Rules 6 + 7 (Users-Create / Users-Update).

post.description:
**Checkbox Create Logic (1:M)**

Called when the user clicks **Submit** on the *User Access Privileges â Create* screen.
Accepts the full set of **checked** AccessPrivilege IDs and creates one
`UserAccessPrivilege` row per checked box.

Rules:
- Validate User is active and belongs to the stated UserType.
- For each `AccessPrivilegeID` in the list:
    - If an **active** row already exists â skip (no duplicate).
    - If a **soft-deleted** row exists â reactivate it (Status=True).
    - Otherwise â create a new row.
- Returns a summary with created/updated counts and the full privilege list.

patch.summary: Bulk-update UAP from checkbox grid â sync full checkbox state (1:M)
patch.description:
**Checkbox Update / Sync Logic (1:M)**

Called when the user clicks **Update** on the *User Access Privileges â Update* screen.
Accepts the **full** set of currently-checked AccessPrivilege IDs and syncs the
database to match.

Rules (per UI spec):
> *"On Update Click, update already existing entries in db,
>  create new entries in case of New Access Privilege in Update Screen"*

- IDs **present** in `AccessPrivilegeIDs`:
    - Row exists + Status=True  â keep (optionally update Description/Status).
    - Row exists + Status=False â reactivate (Status=True).
    - No row â create new.
- IDs **absent** from `AccessPrivilegeIDs`:
    - Row exists + Status=True  â soft-delete (Status=False).
    - Already inactive â no change.

post.summary: Upload all course material files for a Subject in one call
post.description: Accepts the full set of course material uploads for a subject: an optional Syllabus PDF and N units each with M part PDFs. For each file reference, creates an Asset record and a linked CourseMaterialRecord atomically. The caller is expected to have already uploaded the physical files to storage and is providing the resulting StorageURLs here.

get.summary: List all course material records for a Subject
get.description: Returns all CourseMaterialRecords for the given SubjectID, grouped as Syllabus (UnitNumber=null) and Units. Useful to pre-fill the review screens.

UserAccessPrivilegeBulkCreate.title: UserAccessPrivilegeBulkCreate
UserAccessPrivilegeBulkCreate.description:
Bulk-create from checkbox grid.
One POST with N checked boxes â N rows created in UserAccessPrivileges.
Rule: skip boxes that are already active (no duplicate creation).
1:M: User (1) â AccessPrivileges (M)

UserAccessPrivilegeBulkUpdate.title: UserAccessPrivilegeBulkUpdate
UserAccessPrivilegeBulkUpdate.description:
Bulk-update from checkbox grid.
Pass the FULL list of currently-checked box IDs.
- IDs present in list  â Status=True  (create row if new, reactivate if soft-deleted)
- IDs absent from list â Status=False (soft-delete / uncheck)
Rule: "update already existing entries in db, create new entries in case of New Access Privilege"
